Order 
This is third application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.304/2024, dated 06.04.2024 registered at Police Station - Gorakhpur, District Jabalpur (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(1) of IPC and Section 3, 4 of POCSO Act.
Applicant is in detention since 07.04.2024.

Applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed with liberty to renew the prayer for bail after prosecutrix evidence before the trial Court vide order dated 02.05.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.17518/2024.
Second bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed with the direction to the trial Court to conclude the trial within a period of four months.

In case trial is not concluded within the aforesaid period, applicant shall be at liberty to renew the prayer for bail vide NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:60579 2 MCRC-52877-2024 order dated 23.07.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.28629/2024.
2 .
As per prosecution story, on 06.04.2024, 16 years and 05 months old prosecutrix submitted an application in writing before Police that her date of birth is 28.10.2007.
She was having acquaintance with Hariom Kori.

On 06.04.2024 Hariom Kori called her at his house and committed Hariom Kori vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64799010/
1 rape/aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon her.

sentences.text: FIR was registered.
Charge sheet has been filed.
3 . Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
It is contended that the prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court and she has not supported the prosecution story.
Trial could not be concluded within the time period fixed by this Court.
On the aforesaid pretext, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
4 . Counsel for the victim has supported the prayer and has submitted that applicant be released on bail as the prosecutrix and applicant were having consensual sexual relation.

5 . On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant and has submitted that the DNA report is positive and prosecutrix was below 18 years of age.
6. Prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court.

Now there is no possibility of influencing of prosecution witnesses or tempering NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:60579 3 MCRC-52877-2024 with the prosecution evidences.

Therefore, having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing anything on the merit of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre- trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant - Hariom Kori be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Vin**
